description: This source file provides utility functions for reading and parsing process-related information from the /proc filesystem on Linux, including functions to get process owner UIDs, command line arguments, executable paths, environment variables, and parent process IDs.

methods.name: FileOwnerUid
methods.description: Returns the UID of the owner of a specified file path by calling stat.

methods.name: OwnerUids
methods.description: Reads /proc/<pid>/status to extract the real, effective, saved set, and filesystem UIDs of a process.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file at a given path, handling files in /proc which do not have a known size.

methods.name: TokenizeByNullChar
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on null character delimiters, used for parsing environment variables.

methods.name: CollectPids
methods.description: Collects all process IDs owned by a specific UID by scanning /proc.

methods.name: GetCmdArgs
methods.description: Retrieves the command line arguments for a process by reading /proc/<pid>/cmdline.

methods.name: GetExecutablePath
methods.description: Gets the executable path of a process by reading the symbolic link /proc/<pid>/exe.

methods.name: CheckExecNameFromStatus
methods.description: Checks if the process's name matches the expected name by parsing /proc/<pid>/status.

methods.name: CollectPidsByExecName
methods.description: Finds processes matching a specific executable name owned by a UID.

methods.name: CollectPidsByExecPath
methods.description: Finds processes matching a specific executable path owned by a UID.

methods.name: CollectPidsByArgv0
methods.description: Finds processes whose argv[0] matches an expected value, owned by a UID.

methods.name: OwnerUid
methods.description: Gets the real owner UID of a process, falling back to file ownership if necessary.

methods.name: GetEnvs
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables of a process from /proc/<pid>/environ.

methods.name: ExtractProcInfo
methods.description: Collects comprehensive process information into a ProcInfo structure.

methods.name: Ppid
methods.description: Retrieves the parent process ID from /proc/<pid>/status.
